messages:
June (Design): quick UX review from usability session — users want a lighter run-history when using tool-calls. proposing a small 'Condense' pill per invocation that collapses long structured outputs into a compact one-line summary. thoughts?
Marco (Frontend): looks good. implementation note: don't render huge JSON in DOM when condensed. fetch full payload on expand.
Rae (UX): per-invocation default, with an option in the toolbar to 'Apply to all' for power users. also show a one-time coach mark explaining token savings.
Omar (Eng-ML): agreed. backend should expose GET /invokes/:id/raw and run PII/redaction before returning. return a small validation summary in invocation metadata to avoid heavy parsing client-side.
Sam (DevEx): telemetry: condense_toggled, condense_expand, condense_apply_all, expand_latency_ms. require expand latency <300ms for first rollout.
June (Design): a11y nits: control must have aria-expanded, explicit text label (not just icon), keyboard operable, and visible focus ring. tooltip: 'Hides long outputs; click to reveal full payload.'
Marco (Frontend): dev plan: localStorage for per-user pref, project endpoint later. estimate 2d frontend + 1d backend + QA. will open WIP PR and tag @June @Rae for copy/a11y.
flag-bot: feature flag queued -> condense-invocations.
Rae (UX): tiny microcopy suggestion: label = 'Show condensed output', expand button = 'Reveal full output'. add inline "schema mismatch" chip when validation fails with hover text linking to schema editor.
June (Design): perfect. I'll upload a short GIF and final copy after PR lands. :sparkles:
